jobs.title: Head of AI Transformation
jobs.description:
Maya HTT is a world leading developer of digital industries software solutions. The world’s top tier engineering and manufacturing organizations rely on MAYA’s experience and expertise to achieve the full potential of their software investment. Maya HTT is at the forefront of innovation technology. Our team delivers extensive engineering and industrial AI expertise along with cutting-edge digitalization solutions with a focus on industrial data, AI, machine learning, industrial edge, IIoT, operational technologies, and Industry 4.0.

The role

We are hiring a Head of AI Transformation to own Maya HTT's AI strategy and prove it in production across our development, services and reseller businesses. This is a player-coach role: roughly 60% strategy, change and governance, and 40% hands-on building.

Maya HTT is a Montreal-based CAE and PLM software company and a Siemens Digital Industries Software partner. We build our own simulation software, deliver engineering services and custom tools to clients, and resell and support Siemens solutions.

You will turn a growing set of AI initiatives into measurable business results. You will spend as much time with sales and services leaders as with engineers, and you will build the first proofs of value yourself.

Responsibilities

Strategy, change and governance

Build and own the AI transformation roadmap across development, services and VAR, prioritized by business impact.

Write the business case for each initiative, and agree success metrics with each business unit head before work starts.
Lead adoption: run the steering group with business unit leaders, recruit a champion in each unit, and remove blockers.
Work with services leadership on pricing models, so efficiency gains from AI grow margin instead of shrinking billable revenue.
Set the AI usage policy, data classification rules and vendor standards, aligned with our ISO 27001 and EU Cyber Resilience Act work.
Evaluate vendors and tools, including Siemens' AI roadmap, and decide what we build, buy or resell.
Report progress and P&L impact to the CTO and executive team.

Hands-on building

Build prototypes and pilots that prove value fast, especially in services and VAR, using LLM APIs, agents and MCP integrations.
Take successful pilots to production with engineering, using frontier model platforms, MCP and the Maya Agent Platform.
Instrument every pilot so its impact is measured, not estimated.

Qualifications

10+ years in software, engineering or technology leadership, including 3+ years leading AI, automation or digital transformation work.
A track record of driving AI adoption in non-technical business units such as sales, services or support, with results you can quantify.
Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms (such as Anthropic, OpenAI or Microsoft Copilot) and with MCP: you have personally built agents, RAG pipelines or integrations that reached real users.
Enough architecture depth to challenge vendor claims and make sound build-or-buy calls on agents, model hosting and integrations.
Financial fluency: you build business cases and understand how automation changes services pricing and margins.
Working knowledge of AI governance: data classification, security, privacy and regulatory exposure.
The credibility to influence senior business leaders who do not report to you.
Professional English; French is a strong asset.

Nice to have

Experience in CAE, simulation, PLM or engineering software.
Experience in a professional services firm or a software reseller or channel business.
Familiarity with the Siemens Digital Industries Software portfolio.
Experience rolling out enterprise AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise or Microsoft Copilot across a whole company.
Experience with Microsoft 365 data governance, such as Purview.

Why join Maya HTT?

Flex Working Hours and Hybrid Work: Office downtown Montreal, 2-minute walk from Atwater Metro.
Permanent Position and Competitive Base Salary.
100% Employer-Paid Benefits starting from Day One: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short/Long Term disability insurances.
Retirement Savings: Group RRSP / DPSP Plan with Employer Contributions open to join from Day One
Career Growth Opportunities: Our flexible career paths allow you to grow, and we like to promote internally.
Learning Opportunities: Learn from the best in the industry and develop your skills.
Generous Time-Off Policy: We promote a Healthy Work-Life Balance with a Flexible PTO Policy, Sick/Personal Days, and a Summer Flex Schedule.
Structured Onboarding Program: We’re invested in your success; you’ll have team members to support you and provide a wide range of assistance from Day One.
Join an award-winning company that is recognized worldwide as an industry leader.

Our Candidate Experience Flow:
HR Screen - Virtual Interviews using Microsoft Teams - Job Offer

Maya HTT is an equal opportunity employer and committed to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, AI Development
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

OpenText's AI Development and Enablement organization designs and delivers AI solutions that power customer-facing products, agents, and intelligent workflows. We work across the product portfolio, bringing new ideas into applications and building the shared AI technology that helps teams innovate faster.

The Opportunity

As Senior Director of AI Development, you will lead the people and engineering programs that bring OpenText's AI solutions to life. Reporting to the VP, you will build capable teams, establish clear delivery priorities, and turn promising ideas into dependable products and services.

You will work with product and architecture leaders to advance AI applications and the platforms that support them. This role offers the opportunity to lead incubation, shape cloud and platform programs, and help teams apply new AI capabilities to enterprise needs. Success means teams that execute well, ideas that progress into useful capabilities, and services that product teams can confidently adopt and depend on.

You Are Great At

Leading engineering delivery across teams, with clear milestones, effective execution, and accountability for quality, reliability, and customer outcomes. Identifying delivery risks early and removing obstacles to progress.
Hiring, coaching, and developing engineering managers and technical leaders; building teams that combine delivery discipline with curiosity and initiative.
Shaping roadmaps with product and architecture leaders, managing capacity and dependencies, and making timely priority and investment decisions. Balancing new capabilities with service reliability and technical debt.
Leading development of AI solutions, cloud services, and platforms, including tools and shared primitives that enable larger enterprise applications.
Running incubation from focused experiments and customer validation through investment decisions and transition into supported capabilities. Establishing clear criteria for advancing, redirecting, or stopping an initiative.
Establishing development and operational practices that help application teams adopt shared services, including documentation, release readiness, support ownership, and feedback from consuming teams.
Guiding technical discussions and encouraging informed experimentation with emerging AI approaches; building partnerships across business units and communicating progress to executives.

What It Takes

12+ years in software engineering or related disciplines, with a record of delivering complex products and programs across teams through engineering managers and technical leaders.
Proven people leadership, including developing managers, building technical capability, and improving execution across teams.
Enterprise software experience is highly desirable, particularly leading platform or cloud programs and delivering tools, services, and reusable capabilities for application teams.
Experience guiding an applied AI initiative through experimentation and technical decisions into delivery or adoption, with a clear account of your leadership contribution and the outcome.
Current understanding of applied AI concepts, agent patterns, and development challenges, sufficient to lead AI solution development and engage confidently with architects and engineers. Familiarity with how model choices, context, orchestration, and evaluation affect product behavior and delivery.
Demonstrated curiosity and technical currency through hands-on exploration, experimentation, or prior development with AI technologies, with the ability to discuss what you learned and how it informs your leadership decisions.
Sound judgment about AI quality, reliability, security, cost, and operational readiness, with creativity in identifying useful applications and advancing new ideas.
Strong product partnership, cross-business collaboration, and executive communication skills.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and play a pivotal role in shaping the institution's technology roadmap, enterprise systems strategy, and digital future.

About the Role

This role requires a leader who combines strategic thinking, business partnership, and enterprise technology expertise with a passion for transformation and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will lead one of the organization's most significant transformation initiatives, overseeing the implementation, optimization, and long-term success of the Workday ERP platform while providing leadership for IT operations and ensuring secure, reliable, and high-quality technology services.

Located in downtown Toronto, IBU is one of Canada's fastest-growing universities, offering a dynamic academic and professional environment driven by innovation, research, and academic excellence. By joining IBU, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders, support high-impact initiatives, and contribute directly to the success and growth of a dynamic and evolving institution.

What You'll Do

Lead the implementation, optimization, and long-term management of the Workday platform and other enterprise applications.
Develop and execute the organization's enterprise systems and technology roadmap aligned with strategic priorities.
Guide organizational change efforts related to technology initiatives through effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and user adoption programs.

What You Bring/Who You Are

jobs.title: Director, Equipment Planning and Biomedical Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Equipment Planning and Biomedical Services is accountable for clinical and non-clinical asset planning, maintenance and management. The role provides overall leadership to Mackenzie Health equipment needs for short-term and long-term asset planning, tracking, maintenance, management, and refresh. The director is responsible for overseeing all facility and redevelopment work required to plan, procure, and complete installation of medical equipment. This role also provides Director-level leadership to the Central Equipment and Biomedical Engineering departments. This role works within an environment that has Design-Build-Finance-Maintain (DBFP) equipment relationships, Managed Equipment Services (MES) contract, as well as a traditional in-house biomedical engineering service and support model. This role also works closely with Mackenzie Health Redevelopment department to plan, procure, and implement the Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) components of various redevelopment projects. Additionally, the Director coordinates efforts with various departments to develop and maintain a multi-year equipment plan and budget, ensuring appropriate inventory levels, mitigation of corporate risk, and balances demand with broader organizational need.

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain current knowledge of laws, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to corporate purchasing practices.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, develop a multi year clinical technology strategy, in conjunction with clinical and nonclinical leaders, and that aligns with organizational priorities. The strategy must include centralized purchasing/procurement of materials, equipment, machinery, and services required for operations, projects, and capital investments.
Responsible for the implementation of all Equipment projects from needs identification through to commissioning and on-going maintenance.
Manage and oversee all aspects of large-scale equipment installation projects including managing internal and external stakeholders, shop drawing reviews, scope of work development, project schedule development, budget management, reporting, commissioning, training, and close-out documentation.
Work collaboratively with the Digital Health portfolio to ensure all required integrations are planned and implemented to support equipment use.
Provide executive leadership with strategic and tactical advice, as well as risks and opportunities related to emerging healthcare technologies and long-term organizational planning.
Provide advice to management at all levels by using knowledge of equipment market and procurement.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, supervise or manage complex negotiations to settle commercial disputes and claims with suppliers by establishing goals and approving commercial settlements.
Manage the Philips MESP contract ($300M+ over 14-year contract life) and provide support to Philips and the Mackenzie Clinical team in the administration of the MESP contracted services.
Provide direct leadership to Biomedical Engineering and Central Equipment staff and services across a multi site hospital system.
Establish policies and procedures supporting safe equipment use and maintenance.
Lead service contract procurement and negotiations.
Monitor vendor performance and service level agreements.
Develop performance KPI for adequate service and support of medical equipment.
Work with multiple equipment vendors to coordinate design and construction activities, monitor performance and intervene to rectify issues.
Ensure the development and maintenance of work systems, goals and objectives, management systems, teamwork, and resource management for departments within the area of accountability.
Create and maintain asset management and tracking workflows and processes.
Create and maintain a space management program.
Space management includes oversight and recommendations to resolve all space requests. Working collaboratively with Redevelopment, Facilities, Clinical, Clinical Support Teams to ensure space allocations are prioritized and allocated based on hospital priorities.
Act as Chair of the Change Request Group (SAFES) to ensure alignment with corporate vision and mission.
Manage the intake, review, and implementation of all changes related to Space, Aesthetics, Furniture, Equipment, and Signage.
Provide leadership, support, and direction to program staff on issues related to performance, corporate direction, service delivery, staff development, Human Resources Management (HRM), realignment, and change management strategies.
Direct the process of establishing, implementing, and reporting on appropriate quality and productivity indicator measurement tools, based on provincial benchmarks, best practice standards, and legislative requirements.
Co-develop annual budgets and operating plans that align with the hospital’s programs and directives, and ensure the program stays within budget.
Ensure all assigned employees comply with hospital, government, and customer policies, procedures, and regulations.
Build external and internal business relationships to gather information, identify market and industry trends, build partnership and alliances to support and facilitate the hospital’s objectives and plans.
Management of Regulatory Requirements as applicable to equipment installations ensuring all documentation is submitted and approved by appropriate regulatory bodies to support the installation and use of medical equipment (e.g. HARP, CNSC).
Ensure effective procurement activities that meet the requirements and needs of the hospital’s internal stakeholders.
Ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors; investigate, report, debrief and take or direct corrective action as appropriate on incidents.
Manage human resources which include recruitment, selection and training.
Teach, coach and lead staff in the development and monitoring of quality indicators and improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders/organizations/community groups to achieve program objectives, integrate, and link services and foster partnerships across the continuum of service delivery.
Participate in education and training specific to current, relevant federal and provincial health and safety legislation, standards, and guidelines.

What must you have?

Minimum of a Master’s Degree or Master’s ready in Business, Economics, or in a related field, from an accredited university.
Minimum of 5-10 years experience working in equipment planning and procurement within a health care environment.
Minimum of five (5) years’ working in a senior leadership role, preferably in a health care environment.
Biomedical service leadership experience is required or similar experience that is deemed equivalent.
Training or recent experience with drafting requests for proposals and vendor agreements is required.

What else do you bring?

Strong knowledge of hospital operations.
Demonstrated experience in negotiating and managing large, complex contracts.
Demonstrated knowledge of the appropriate tools for grading, analyzing, and assessing materials, equipment, supplies, services, and other commodities.
Demonstrated knowledge of Supply Chain Management (SCM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) software.
Demonstrated excellent critical and logical thinking, analysis, and reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.
Demonstrated project management, change management, and analytical thinking skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams toward a vision, while maintaining group cohesiveness and effectiveness.
Demonstrated strategic business sense with financial management and budget development skills.
Demonstrated understanding of interrelationships between clinical and support programs.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex systems and human resources at the executive level.
Demonstrated leadership skills with ability to foster relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to coach, advise and teach others using the principles of adult learning.
Demonstrated training, experience, or utilization of lean methodology for process improvement.
Demonstrated ability to independently identify issues, plan improvements, measure success and continue improvement.
Proven attendance record.
Demonstrates understanding and complies with patient and staff safety policies and procedures that foster a safe and inclusive environment for all.
Ability to perform the essential duties of the job.
Effectively uses empathy in interactions with others.
Demonstrates behaviours consistent with Mackenzie Health’s Commitment to Caring.
Models behaviour that is aligned with the values of Mackenzie Health – Excellence, Leadership and Empathy.
Commitment to providing an exceptional experience for staff and clients within a challenging and exciting health care environment.

Preferably, Your Profile Also Includes

Additional specialized training will be considered an asset (e.g. Professional Certification in Supply Chain Logistics (P. Log) or a Designation as a Supply Chain Management Professional (SCMP).
You may be required to work at any site of Mackenzie Health.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Integration Services – OneRBC: CNB Integration
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Join RBC's US CIO Technology Strategy and Architecture team as Director, Enterprise Integration Services for the OneRBC: CNB Integration program—a transformational, multi-year initiative that will reshape how RBC operates post-acquisition. In this strategic role, you'll architect and drive the technology integration of City National Bank into RBC's operating model, designing solutions that enable seamless cross-entity operations while establishing repeatable playbooks for future M&A activities.

This is a career-defining opportunity where you'll partner with RBC and CNB enterprise leadership to synthesize complex requirements into cohesive technology strategies spanning identity & access management, cloud infrastructure, network architecture, security posture alignment, and modern workplace modernization. You'll own the validation and de-risking of integration decisions through proof-of-concept initiatives, ensuring solutions deliver tangible business outcomes while maintaining enterprise standards and regulatory compliance.

Beyond CNB, you'll build RBC's M&A integration capability—establishing integration playbooks, standards, and governance models that position RBC to confidently and efficiently integrate future acquisitions. If you're a strategic thinker with deep Microsoft and infrastructure expertise, comfort with constructive challenge, and passion for building organization-scale solutions, this role offers the scope and impact to make a lasting difference at an enterprise scale.

What will you do?

Strategic Integration Design & Delivery

Develop end-to-end integration plans and solutions: Define and evolve technology integration for CNB across identity, cloud, network, security, and workplace domains.
Synthesize requirements into phased roadmaps: Translate competing business/technical needs into actionable plans, balancing trade-offs (e.g., security vs. usability).
Drive alignment with RBC standards: Partner with enterprise teams to ensure CNB solutions adhere to RBC frameworks while fostering innovation.

Stakeholder Leadership & Alignment

Act as technical liaison: Bridge CNB leadership, RBC CIO, and enterprise teams to maintain alignment on priorities.
Communicate complex decisions to executives: Present integration trade-offs and business cases in clear, non-technical terms.
Facilitate cross-functional consensus: Lead design reviews and build trust to resolve conflicts among infrastructure, security, and operations teams.

Solution Validation & De-Risking

Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives: Validate integration assumptions (e.g., identity federation, network testing) before scaling.
Define success criteria and baselines: Establish metrics to ensure solution efficacy.
Align with modern SDLC practices: Collaborate with development teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native patterns.

M&A Integration Capability Building

Codify playbooks and reference architectures: Document CNB integration patterns for reuse in future acquisitions.
Establish governance models: Create standards for technology discovery, risk mitigation, and deployment across M&A scenarios.
Build and mentor integration talent: Develop RBC’s M&A capability by identifying and grooming future leaders.

Operational Readiness & Governance

Ensure sustainable operations: Partner with support teams to define runbooks, escalation processes, and continuous improvement.
Maintain regulatory compliance: Align solutions with financial services regulations and audit standards (e.g., cross-border requirements).
Monitor and optimize post-deployment: Drive enhancements using user feedback, metrics, and lessons learned.

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
10–12+ years in technology integration, infrastructure, or security leadership roles.
5+ years in architect/senior technical leadership roles, leading complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts.
Deep Microsoft expertise: Azure, Entra ID/Azure AD, Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams), hybrid identity, and federated access.
Broad infrastructure & security experience: Network architecture, firewall design, cloud infrastructure, IAM, zero-trust principles, and compliance frameworks.
Financial services regulatory knowledge: Understanding of Canadian/US banking compliance and operational models.
SDLC fluency: Modern software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization.
Strategic communication: Ability to translate technical concepts for C-suite audiences and influence senior leadership.

Nice to have:

Familiarity with RBC’s technology landscape, architecture frameworks, and governance models.
Prior involvement in technology integration during mergers/acquisitions.
Multi-tenant architecture: Experience designing solutions for complex, federated organizational structures.
Proven ability to operate effectively in large, complex, matrix-structured environments.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities.
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
A world-class training program in financial services.
Opportunities to do challenging work.

jobs.title: Chief Financial and Operating Officer – Casey House
jobs.description:
Career opportunities are presented in the language received.

Casey House is a specialty hospital in Toronto providing ground-breaking care to people living with and at risk of HIV. They are Canada’s first and only hospital for people living with and at risk of HIV and have a holistic and interdisciplinary approach to health and well-being. Building on a legacy of advocacy and social justice, Casey House actively dismantles barriers to care and safe living, providing a community and sense of belonging that connects people to care.

Casey House offers comprehensive inpatient, outpatient, and community-based holistic health care for people living with and at risk of HIV. They recognize a person’s physical, mental, cultural, and social well-being as fundamental components of wellness.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Financial and Operating Officer (CFOO) serves as an integral member of the Casey House and Casey House Foundation Executive team. jobs.title: Sales Leader, Enterprise - Americas
jobs.description:
Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About This Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team - West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

Own the revenue outcomes for the segment, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large-scale competitive replacement deals.
Build a high caliber team in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.
Establish a reputation for excellence by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering & Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.

In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You Could Be a Great Fit If

💼 You’ve led and scaled a team of SaaS Enterprise Account Executives delivering $5M/yr+ at a company that has scaled beyond $100M ARR
💰 You have helped win $1M+ SaaS deals with publicly traded companies, and can help your team see around corners on complex deals
🥇 You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding Ent AEs who can create their own pipeline and close both more tactical ($100k) and strategic ($500k+) deals
📊 You have a strong mental model for enterprise sales execution. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.
🤝 You build trusted relationships with customers and confidently facilitate peer-to-peer conversations between senior leaders to deepen partnerships and elevate strategic engagements.
🤓 You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.
⚙️ You have successfully sold a complex multi-product platform and have won competitive rip-and-replace sales motions.

Bonus

You have sold to Talent and/or People leaders and are familiar with their pains and priorities

You Shouldn't Apply If

You're a dashboard-and-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations
You're not keen on learning our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

Our Philosophy

Here Are a Few Key Points That Should Give You An Idea Of What It Is Like To Work With Us

We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby
We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals
We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience
We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Enterprise segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.
Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today.
Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with pipeline data and seek your perspective on the segment. You'll discuss your approach to hiring, coaching and sales execution.
Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional leaders

Benefits

A product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about
Competitive salary, commission and equity.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Compensation Range: $320K - $407.5K

new_jobs.description:
Lead Transformation. Drive Digital Innovation. Shape the Future.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and play a pivotal role in shaping the institution's technology roadmap, enterprise systems strategy, and digital future.

About the Role

This role requires a leader who combines strategic thinking, business partnership, and enterprise technology expertise with a passion for transformation and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will lead one of the organization's most significant transformation initiatives, overseeing the implementation, optimization, and long-term success of the Workday ERP platform while providing leadership for IT operations and ensuring secure, reliable, and high-quality technology services.

Title:
Director, Information Technology & Enterprise Systems

Type:
Full-Time, Permanent

Department:
Information Technology & Information Systems (IT/IS)

Reporting to
: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Location:
Toronto, Ontario

Existing Vacancy:
Yes

Compensation Range:
$120,000 - $150,000 annually

Why Join IBU

Located in downtown Toronto, IBU is one of Canada's fastest-growing universities, offering a dynamic academic and professional environment driven by innovation, research, and academic excellence. By joining IBU, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders, support high-impact initiatives, and contribute directly to the success and growth of a dynamic and evolving institution.

What You'll Do

Lead the implementation, optimization, and long-term management of the Workday platform and other enterprise applications.
Develop and execute the organization's enterprise systems and technology roadmap aligned with strategic priorities.
Guide organizational change efforts related to technology initiatives through effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and user adoption programs.
Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, service delivery, and user experience across the institution.
Oversee enterprise applications supporting Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Student Services, and other core business functions.
Establish strong governance, data integrity, reporting, and business process improvement practices across enterprise systems.
Provide leadership for IT operations, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-quality technology services.
Lead cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery initiatives.
Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IT support and enterprise systems professionals.
Manage technology vendors, contracts, budgets, and external partners to maximize value and service quality.

What You Bring/Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise technology leadership, ERP implementations, and digital transformation initiatives, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role.
Proven success leading large-scale ERP implementation, optimization, or modernization programs, with experience across the full project lifecycle.
Experience managing enterprise applications supporting Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Student Information Systems, or other critical business functions.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive organizational change, and build strong partnerships with diverse stakeholders.
Experience developing technology strategies, governance frameworks, service delivery models, and operational improvement initiatives.
Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and make effective decisions in fast-paced, high-impact environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience leading a full-cycle Workday implementation or major Workday transformation initiative.
Experience in higher education, post-secondary institutions, or similarly complex service-oriented organizations, including knowledge of student systems, registrar functions, enrollment management, and academic operations.
Certifications Considered Assets: Workday implementation, administration, or functional certifications, Microsoft Power Platform certifications, ITIL, PMP, Agile, or similar project/service management certifications.

Additional Information

To support the overall well-being and success of our employees, IBU offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package, which may include the following, based on role eligibility:

100% employer-paid extended Health & Dental benefits
24/7 access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and virtual healthcare services
Life, Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D), and Long-Term Disability insurance
Competitive paid time off, starting at three weeks
Tuition Benefit Program
Access to preferred corporate membership rates with GoodLife Fitness
Engaging employee appreciation and community-building events

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Enterprise segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.
Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today.
Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with pipeline data and seek your perspective on the segment. You'll discuss your approach to hiring, coaching and sales execution.
Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional leaders
